articles.title: Boris Johnson says UK must lead blockchain development despite crypto doubts
articles.snippet: Johnson was joined by Lord Ross Kempsell who called for regulators to work with industry participants to bring the UK to the forefront.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls to 4-month low near $62K as crypto selloff deepens
articles.snippet: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization fell 4% to $2.26 trillion over 24 hours, while Ether and Solana posted double-digit weekly losses.

articles.title: 'Nobody Knows Who's in Charge': Boris Johnson Stands by Bitcoin Skepticism at Breakpoint
articles.snippet: The former UK prime minister told a Solana conference he backs blockchain but still doubts Bitcoin, months after calling it a Ponzi.

articles.title: German Lawmakers Back Customs Powers to Seize Crypto of 'Unclear Origin'
articles.snippet: A new law lets Germany's customs agency freeze assets worth more than €100,000 without a criminal case if their origin is in doubt.

articles.title: Trump’s First Democratic Picks for SEC and CFTC Could Reshape Crypto’s Regulators
articles.snippet: The bipartisan slate—two Republicans and two Democrats, Trump’s first Democratic picks for either agency—would refill commissions that have driven crypto policy since the Clarity Act’s collapse.
